responsibility: Implements LTO serialization and deserialization of GCC’s interprocedural symbol table and callgraph data. This file owns the encoding of symtab nodes into per-partition indices, tracks whether functions, variables, bodies, and initializers belong to a streamed partition, and reads/writes the LTO symtab, call edges, references, asm nodes, and callgraph optimization summaries such as clone and parameter-adjustment information. It sits at the IPA/LTO boundary: consuming cgraph/varpool state from the compiler and producing or reconstructing the compact object-file representation used by WPA and LTRANS.
